_extraction_notes.revenue_line_mapping: Oracle's GAAP income statement reports four revenue lines: 'Cloud services and license support' (combined cloud services + on-premise license support), 'Cloud license and on-premise license' (new license revenue), 'Hardware', and 'Services'. In this schema they are mapped as revenue.cloud = 'Cloud services and license support' and revenue.software = 'Cloud license and on-premise license', using Oracle's own reported figures verbatim (no re-allocation or estimation).
_extraction_notes.capex_sign_convention: capex_quarter and capex figures are stored as positive magnitudes (spend), consistent with the source press releases' Free Cash Flow tables. free_cash_flow_quarter = operating_cash_flow_quarter - capex_quarter.
_extraction_notes.quarterly_cash_flow_derivation: Oracle's Q2, Q3, and Q4 (and full-year) press releases present GAAP cash flow statements on a year-to-date (cumulative fiscal-year) basis, not discrete-quarter. Discrete quarterly operating cash flow and capex for Q2-Q4 were derived by subtracting the prior cumulative period (from the prior quarter's own 8-K Exhibit 99.1) from the current cumulative period, both sourced from Oracle's own SEC filings. Q1 figures are reported directly on a discrete 3-month basis. Cross-check: sum of the four derived/reported quarterly operating cash flows (7,427+1,304+5,933+6,157=20,821) equals the FY2025 full-year GAAP operating cash flow of $20,821M exactly, and sum of quarterly capex (2,303+3,970+5,862+9,080=21,215) equals FY2025 full-year capex of $21,215M exactly, and the resulting FY FCF of -394 matches the free-cash-flow trailing-4-quarter table printed in the Q4 exhibit ($(394)M) -- validating the derivation.
_extraction_notes.rpo_disclosure: Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO) totals are disclosed in each press release only as rounded headline figures (e.g. '$99 billion'), not to the exact million, and no exact-dollar RPO figure appears elsewhere in the Exhibit 99.1 press releases. Values below are recorded in $ millions at the rounded precision disclosed (e.g. 99000 for '$99 billion') with the YoY % change as stated.
_extraction_notes.guidance_disclosure: Oracle's Exhibit 99.1 earnings press releases for Q1-Q3 FY2025 do not contain a quantified forward-guidance table (no next-quarter revenue growth %, cloud growth %, or non-GAAP EPS range). Quantified guidance of this kind is typically given verbally on the earnings conference call (a separate document, not part of this 8-K exhibit) and was NOT extracted here to preserve strict SEC-filing sourcing. The Q4/FY2025 release contains only qualitative FY2026 outlook commentary from the CEO (quoted in guidance_issued._note for FY2025Q4), not a quantified guidance table.
_extraction_notes.preferred_dividends: Oracle has no preferred stock outstanding in FY2025; preferred_dividends is 0 in all periods and net_income_common equals net_income.

source.title: Oracle Q4 & Full Year FY2025 Earnings Press Release (Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K)

revenue._note: cloud = 'Cloud services and license support'; software = 'Cloud license and on-premise license' (Oracle's own line labels).

cash_flow._note: Q4-only quarterly figures derived: FY2025 full-year cumulative (OCF $20,821M; capex $21,215M) minus Q3's cumulative nine-month figures (OCF $14,664M; capex $12,135M) from the Q3 8-K Exhibit 99.1. Full-year figures are reported directly in the Q4/FY exhibit's Year Ended May 31, 2025 cash flow statement. Cross-check: sum of all four quarters' operating cash flow (7,427+1,304+5,933+6,157) = 20,821 = FY total; sum of all four quarters' capex (2,303+3,970+5,862+9,080) = 21,215 = FY total; resulting FY free cash flow of $(394)M matches the Free Cash Flow - Trailing 4-Quarters table printed in this same exhibit exactly.

rpo.note_en: Q4 Remaining Performance Obligations up 41% year-over-year to $138 billion, as stated in the press release headline (not disclosed to the exact million in the exhibit).
rpo.note_es: Las Obligaciones de Desempeno Restantes del 4T aumentaron 41% interanual a $138 mil millones, segun el titular del comunicado (no se revela al millon exacto en el anexo).

guidance_issued._note: No quantified next-quarter (Q1 FY2026) guidance table is contained in this Exhibit 99.1 press release. Initial FY2026 full-year outlook IS given, but only qualitatively (as direct CEO quotes), not as specific $ revenue or EPS figures: CEO Safra Catz stated Oracle expects 'total cloud growth rate -- applications plus infrastructure -- will increase from 24% in FY25 to over 40% in FY26,' 'Cloud Infrastructure growth rate is expected to increase from 50% in FY25 to over 70% in FY26,' and 'RPO is likely to grow more than 100% in FY26.' Chairman/CTO Larry Ellison added that MultiCloud database revenue grew 115% quarter-over-quarter and that 'triple-digit MultiCloud revenue growth' is expected to continue in FY26, and that Oracle Cloud Infrastructure consumption revenue 'grew 62% in Q4' with growth expected to accelerate further in FY26. These are the only FY2026 guidance-related statements in the exhibit; fy_total_revenue_at_least and fy_non_gaap_eps were not quantified and are left null per instructions rather than estimated.
